# P31.11 — Human decisions into camera-site clustering (P31)

- **Semantic id:** `DEEPEN.7` · **Phase:** 31 · **Kind:** ticket · **Tag:** p31-followups · **Wave:** B
- **base_branch:** `devin/p31-10-camera-site-review-surface` · **Depends on:** P31.10 (decisions exist in PG), P30.2b (camera-site ER)
- **Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/P31.11__review-decisions-into-clustering.md live_verification=true`
- **Gate status:** engineering.

## Goal
An accepted camera-site proposal becomes a human same_as edge that the next camera-site run clusters. A rejected one
never clusters. A source that republishes its own layer under two targets is recognized by target-level lineage
evidence, while genuinely distinct same-source devices at one point still never merge.

## Load (cite; do not copy)
- `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` rows **D-P30.2b-1**, **D-P30.2b-3**. ADR-105 (constraints (a)/(b)/(c); holdout discipline
  §5), ADR-099. Spec §14.7 (SIG-IDENT-024/027/028/029), SIG-IDENT-032 (public-id lifecycle).
- Code: `resolution/src/resolution/camera_sites.py` (constraints `:38-49`, same-source refusal `:685-692`, alerts

## In scope — deliverables
1. **Human edges (ADR-R9-HUMANER).** The camera-site run reads `review_decision` for `er_match:camera_site*` items.
   `accept` → a human same_as edge (disposition `human_accept`, `decided_by` = curator). `reject` → a hard cannot-link.
   `unsure` → stays proposed. Precedence: a human decision outranks any later auto decision on the same pair; a
   conflict between two humans → stays proposed and is routed back. Human edges still respect constraints (b)/(c). An
   accepted edge that would violate one is recorded and refused, never silently applied.
2. **Stability.** Re-clustering keeps public ids stable per SIG-IDENT-032, and each run records how many clusters
   changed because of human decisions. `camera_site_run.summary` counts human accepts, rejects and conflicts.
3. **Within-source duplicate targets.** Record target-level lineage: two targets of one source whose captured content
   digests are identical (or row-identical) are marked `duplicate_target_of`. The ER then treats their record pairs
   as the same record (one lineage), which is an exception to constraint (a) that exists **only** with that evidence.
   A test pins that distinct same-source devices at one point still never merge.
4. **Metric.** "N resolved sites" counts human accepts, and the population note says how many proposals still await review.
**Split seam** (if the working set overflows): (1)+(2)+(4) human edges, stability and metric | (3) the
duplicate-target lineage (with its ADR section).

5. **Hosted.** Run camera-sites as a Cloud Run job (SHA-tagged). With 0 decisions the result is identical to the last
   run apart from the duplicate-target change (measured). Re-run +0. Add a RETURN PASS note: re-run after P31.17
   decisions accrue.

## Out of scope
- Rules v3, the soft conflicts of D-P30.2b-2, and a new holdout (P31.18). Threshold changes (P31.18 ADR).
- Doing the reviewing (P31.17).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Accepted proposal → clustered next run (N drops by one); rejected → never clustered; human conflict → stays proposed (real-PG tests) *(deterministic)*.
- [ ] Duplicate-target lineage merges identical-target records; distinct same-source devices never merge (tests) *(deterministic)*.
- [ ] Public ids are stable across re-cluster (test); the run summary records the human-decision counts.
- [ ] Hosted camera-sites run: measured delta, re-run +0 *(live)*.
- [ ] ADR-R9-HUMANER with `## Revisit trigger` + Appendix F row; D-P30.2b-3 → DONE; D-P30.2b-1 **stays OPEN** with a note appended (the wiring has landed; its verify needs real accepted decisions clustering on hosted, which P31.18 does after P31.17); `make check` + `make test-db` green.

## Cross-cutting invariants
Cited from `docs/tickets/00_MANIFEST.md` and design §5: append-only decisions and runs; constraint (a) is absolute
except for evidenced target duplication; holdout discipline (no tuning to the retired v1 or frozen v2 holdouts);
the PROVISIONAL disclosure stays; hosted work runs as a Cloud Run job; re-run +0; no merge/tag/push-main.
